source_title: Staff Termination Row: JU forms inquiry panel on confidential note leak - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Kolkata: JU vice-chancellor Chiranjib Bhattacharjee has formed an internal inquiry committee to probe the alleged unauthorised disclosure and circulation of a confidential communication between him and acting registrar Debajit Dutta. The move follows a complaint lodged by Dutta with the VC.JU this month issued a circular terminating the tenure of more than 70 re-employed or re-engaged staff members with effect from Oct 15. Teachers and staff protested the decision, alleging that it violated Section 29 of the Jadavpur University Act, 1981.
